research_question: Can repeated prior task learning with explicit erasure of episode-fast weights improve ECS_G held-out adaptation to unseen associations, beyond cold and shuffled-history controls, and relative to a matched FFN?
interpretation_guard: Tests explicit first-order Reptile meta-learning with fast-parameter reset, not spontaneous Levin-style causal emergence or self-improving general intelligence. A forgetting probe shows loss of previously fitted task performance, not full information-theoretic erasure.

qualification.comparison_policy: Primary bounded retained learning utility is evaluated within ECS. FFN comparative superiority is reported independently.

controls.ECS_COLD: Always reset to initial ECS parameters; no across-episode slow changes
controls.ECS_META: Fast inner SGD, slow first-order Reptile across TRAIN episodes, reset fast weights after every episode
controls.ECS_SHUFFLED: Same Reptile but shuffled training support-target pairing for the slow state
controls.ECS_CONTINUAL: Continuous adaptation to TRAIN episodes without erasing task-specific fast weights
controls.FFN_META: 120-parameter matched GELU FFN under identical episode protocol and Reptile update
controls.FORGET_PROBE: Previously trained task query error before vs after fast reset into slow state

portability.historical_parents: Recorded identifiers and hashes only; not reattested in this package.
portability.numerical_protocol: Retained from reviewed R97W source; only authority/output handling adapted.
